# Read your DMARC reports without paying for a dashboard

> Drop your DMARC aggregate reports (.xml, .gz or .zip) and see which senders pass SPF and DKIM alignment, which fail and exactly why, and when it is safe to move from p=none to quarantine or reject. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
